text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.

text: Given the cognitive decline and normal DaTscan, I need to rule out other neurodegenerative conditions. Do you have any history of visual hallucinations or significant fluctuations in attention and alertness throughout the day? REQUEST TEST: Neuropsychological_Evaluation

speaker: Patient
text: Denies any other systemic complaints. Specifically, no urinary symptoms, no significant changes in bowel habits, no reported falls or dizziness.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal DaTscan and neuropsychological results, I am concerned about vascular parkinsonism or another non-degenerative cause. speaker: Doctor
